config.title: Flutter Phone Preview
config.device: Phone model shown when the preview opens. It can also be changed from the panel dropdown.
config.device.iphone_16_pro_max: iPhone 16 Pro Max (large screen, with Dynamic Island)
config.enableRestProxy: Allow REST HTTP/HTTPS consumption from the preview without CORS blocks via a local proxy. Compatible with fetch and XMLHttpRequest (http/Dio). Uses header authentication; does not share cookies with APIs. Restart the preview when changing this option.
config.persistPreferences: Keep the app's shared_preferences values between preview restarts, stored per project. Restart the preview when changing this option.
config.autoReloadOnSave: When saving a .dart file, automatically send a hot reload to Flutter and refresh the panel when recompilation finishes.
config.language: Extension language. Window reload required when changing this option.
